title: Settlement
description: The final outcome of one market — settled for every observed eligible market, not only placed bets, so unbet market families remain researchable. hypothetical returns are price-dependent, never reduced to a bare win/loss count.

outcome.description: Underlying game/market fact the settlement was derived from, e.g. 'away_won_f5'

settlementStatus.description: UNAVAILABLE/SETTLEMENT_UNRESOLVED must carry a reason; never silently guessed

result.description: Whether the YES side of THIS EXACT TICKER settled true — every Kalshi market, including each team's own moneyline/result ticker, is its own independent binary question, so this is always YES/NO, never a 3-way AWAY/HOME/TIE value. Independent of whether anyone bet it. A placed bet's own WIN/LOSS/PUSH/VOID (PlacedBet.result) is derived by comparing this to the bet's side (YES bet + YES result = WIN), not stored redundantly here.

hypotheticalReturnsByCheckpoint.description: Price-dependent hypothetical $1-stake return at each recorded checkpoint quote, for research into unbet markets

hypotheticalYesReturn.description: (1 - yesPrice)/yesPrice on a win, -1 on a loss, 0 on a push/void, per $1 staked on YES

betId.description: Set when a real bet exists on this market

realizedReturn.description: Actual dollar return — only ever populated when betId is set

wasRecommended.description: True if any Recommendation row for this ticker (any run, that date) reached WATCH/RECOMMENDED/RECOMMENDED_NOT_BET/BET_PLACED -- i.e. the model or a human analysis actually surfaced this market, not merely observed/extended-coverage. Null only when the recommendations ledger for the date wasn't available to check (never guessed).

wasPlaced.description: True if betId is set (a real, non-CANCELLED bet exists on this exact ticker). Denormalized copy of 'betId is not null' for query convenience -- never a separate source of truth.

settlementEvidence.description: GitHub issue #43 (player-prop settlement): the exact authoritative facts a player-prop settlement was derived from, so it is independently auditable back to game/player/statistic/source. Null for every non-player-prop settlement and for a player-prop market settled before this field existed.

gameStatus.description: Authoritative MLB Stats API detailedState at fetch time, e.g. 'Final'

sourcePayloadHash.description: sha1 of the raw feed payload actually used -- lets a settlement be traced back to the exact response without committing the full feed

playerId.description: MLBAM player id -- the real resolved identity, never the Kalshi ticker's jersey-number-style token

playerName.description: Official MLB Stats API fullName of the resolved player

rawPlayerToken.description: The Kalshi ticker's own player-identifying segment, verbatim -- audit/corroboration only, never itself an MLB player id

statFields.description: The specific final boxscore stat sub-fields used to derive actualValue, e.g. {"hits": 2} or {"inningsPitched": "5.1", "outsDerivedFromInningsPitched": true}

kalshiOfficialResult.description: Kalshi's own official result for this exact ticker, when this repository's ingestion ever captures one (it does not today -- see lib/edgelab/player_prop_settlement.py's module docstring)

candidates.description: Every exact-normalized-name candidate found in this game's two rosters -- populated even when resolutionStatus is NOT_FOUND (empty) or AMBIGUOUS (2+), for audit
